Elaine: Quick deploy question — who's on deploy for the canary tomorrow 10:30 PDT? Need smoke owner + rollback lead and cohort split. Also want a tiny EU mobile micro-cohort to validate region-specific routing.

Matt: I'm on deploy. 10:30 PDT works for me. Deployer: Matt + Sam. Smoke owner: Jasper. Rollback lead: Ricardo. Will do preflight at 10:00. @Jasper you good to own smoke?

Sam: Can we do 5% -> 20% -> 50% with holds? Suggested holds: 10m @5%, 15m @20%, 20m @50%. EU mobile as micro-cohort: start at 0.5% (split from global 5%) then fold at 20%.

Jasper: +1 to that cadence. I'll own the smoke checklist and run the healthboard. Gating signals I'd like on watch: p95 latency <200ms, error rate <0.3%, no OOMs. No config flips during ramp unless green for 30m.

Ricardo: I'll be rollback lead. Rollback plan: flip traffic to stable tag `v2026-03-10`. I'll handle any migration rollbacks if needed. Quick rollback trigger rules: sustained error increase >0.5% for 5m OR latency p95 >300ms for 3m.

Ricardo: Smoke checklist snippet:
```
smoke checklist:
- run `curl -fsS https://canary.internal/health`
- run sample generate `/api/generate` (5 prompts)
- sample gen latency < 200ms
- quality heuristics: 5 samples pass basic filters
- token cost delta < 5% vs baseline
- logs: no 5xx spike / no new stack traces
```

Elaine: Nice. @deploy-bot can you schedule and attach the deploy doc & add on-call rotation?

deploy-bot: Scheduled deploy: 2026-03-18 10:30 PDT (thread_ts=1758123456). Canary steps: 5% (10m) -> 20% (15m) -> 50% (20m). Added tag: `eu-mobile` microcohort (0.5% start). Assigned owners: Matt, Sam, Jasper, Ricardo. Release doc: https://releases.redwood/infer/2026-03-18-canary :rocket:

Sam: Quick Q — who runs the post-step evals? We should validate for quality regressions after each hold.

Matt: I'll run the eval harness after each hold and post results here. Using `evals/canary_smoke_v1` (lightweight). CI PR #1234 merged and green.

Jasper: I'll watch SLO dashboards and alerting. If any gating signals breach I'll call rollback per Ricardo's plan.

Elaine: Thanks all — if nobody objects I'll mark this ready in the release doc and send calendar invites. :thumbsup:

Matt: No objections from me. Ready to go.

Sam: All set from my side.

Ricardo: Ready. I'll be on-call for rollback window.

Jasper: Good to go on my end.

Elaine: OK locking. See you tomorrow 10:00 preflight.
